title: Datadog US1 - March Scheduled Maintenance Window
text:
Service: Datadog US1
Maintenance: March Scheduled Maintenance Window
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2017-03-03T21:00:00.000-05:00
Scheduled until: 2017-03-03T23:00:00.000-05:00
Updates:
- 2017-03-03T21:16:46.048-05:00: completed - The maintenance is complete.
- 2017-03-03T21:00:27.064-05:00: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2017-02-28T12:18:36.560-05:00: scheduled - We will be performing proactive maintenance for a window of no longer than 2 hours this Friday. 
The window will start at 2017-03-03 21:00 EST (2017-03-04 01:00 UTC). 
During this period, you may come across our 'down' page, but that is to be expected. There may be a brief period during this maintenance window when alerts may not be sent. In this event, we will keep our Status Page updated here. 
*Most importantly*, all of your data will be processed. 
If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us at support@datadoghq.com
